arxiv-1410-4403.title: BEAM–BEAM EFFECTS IN THE HIGH-PILE-UP TESTS OF THE LHC
arxiv-1410-4403.creator: G. Trad, CERN, Geneva, Switzerland
arxiv-1410-4403.description: Abstract Investigating the beam–beam limit in the LHC is of great importance, since identifying its source is crucial for the luminosity optimization scenario. Several experiments were carried out to search for this limit and check whether it is dominated by the head-on (HO) or the long-range (LR) interactions.

arxiv-2208-10505.creator: Raphael Marschall, David Nesvorný, Rogerio Deienno, Ian Wong, Harold F. Levison, William F. Bottke
arxiv-2208-10505.description: Abstract In this work, we model the collisional evolution of the Jupiter Trojans and determined under which conditions the Eurybates-Queta system survives. We show that the collisional strength of the Jupiter Trojans and the age of the Eurybates family and by extension Queta are correlated. The collisional grinding of the Jupiter Trojan population over 4.5 4.

arxiv-2303-13942.title: Modulation instability and convergence of the random phase approximation for stochastic sea states
arxiv-2303-13942.creator: Agissilaos G. Athanassoulis, Irene Kyza
arxiv-2303-13942.description: Abstract The nonlinear Schrödinger equation is widely used as an approximate model for the evolution in time of the water wave envelope. In the context of simulating ocean waves, initial conditions are typically generated from a measured power spectrum using the random phase approximation, and periodized on an interval of length L L .

arxiv-2410-22798.title: Coupled-cluster theory for the ground state and for excitations
arxiv-2410-22798.creator: Andreas Grüneis, Evgeny Moerman, Matthias Scheffler *, Tonghao Shen, Igor Ying Zhang
arxiv-2410-22798.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by Andreas Grüneis, Evgeny Moerman, Matthias Scheffler *, Tonghao Shen, Igor Ying Zhang. Summary

In the molecular quantum chemistry community, coupled-cluster (CC) methods are well-recognized for
their systematic convergence and reliability. The extension of
the theory to extended systems has been comparably recent
[
1
]
, so that developments and studies of periodic CC methods for both the ground-state and for excited states are still active fields
of research and provide valuable benchmark data when the
reliability of density functional approximations is questionable.

arxiv-2502-02161.title: A plug-and-play solution for characterizing two-way optical frequency transfer over free-space
arxiv-2502-02161.creator: Jingxian Ji, 1,2,* Shambo Mukherjee, 1 Alexander Kuhl, 1 Sebastian Koke, 1 Markus Leipe, 3,4 Markus Rothe, 3 Fabian Steinlechner, 3,4 and Jochen Kronjäger 1
arxiv-2502-02161.description: Abstract Optical clock networks connected by phase-coherent links offer significant potential for advancing fundamental research and diverse scientific applications. Free-space optical frequency transfer extends fiber-based connectivity to remote areas and holds the potential for global coverage via satellite links. Here we present a compact and robust portable, rack-integrated two-way free-space link characterization system.

arxiv-2504-00639.title: Coca-Splat: Collaborative Optimization for Camera Parameters and 3D Gaussians
arxiv-2504-00639.creator: Jiamin Wu, Hongyang Li, Xiaoke Jiang, Yuan YAO, Lei Zhang
arxiv-2504-00639.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jiamin Wu, Hongyang Li, Xiaoke Jiang, Yuan YAO, Lei Zhang. In this work, we introduce Coca-Splat , a novel approach to addressing the challenges of sparse view pose-free scene reconstruction and novel view synthesis (NVS) by jointly optimizing camera parameters with 3D Gaussians. Inspired by deformable DEtection TRansformer, we design separate queries for 3D Gaussians and camera parameters and update them layer by layer through deformable Transformer layers, enabling joint optimization in a single network.

arxiv-2511-12371.title: Reasoning Text-to-Video Retrieval via Digital Twin Video Representations and Large Language Models
arxiv-2511-12371.creator: Yiqing Shen, Chenxiao Fan, Chenjia Li, Mathias Unberath
arxiv-2511-12371.description: Abstract The goal of text-to-video retrieval is to search large databases for relevant videos based on text queries. Existing methods have progressed to handling explicit queries where the visual content of interest is described explicitly; however, they fail with implicit queries where identifying videos relevant to the query requires reasoning.

pmc-10647448.creator: Ryoung-Eun Ko, Zero Kim, Bomi Jeon, Migyeong Ji, Chi Ryang Chung, Gee Young Suh, Myung Jin Chung, Baek Hwan Cho, Yudong Zhang, Juan Manuel Gorriz, Zhengchao Dong

Cancer patients can have serious problems due to their treatment or cancer itself. A quick response system is used to find and treat these patients.

pmc-10747869.title: Exploration of the Pathogenesis of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease Caused by Smoking—Based on Bioinformatics Analysis and In Vitro Experimental Evidence
pmc-10747869.creator: Yingchi Zhang, Yuxin Sheng, Yanrong Gao, Yujia Lin, Bin Cheng, Hongmei Li, Ling Zhang, Haiming Xu, Jinglong Tang, Rong Zhang
pmc-10747869.description: This study was aimed at investigating the pathogenesis of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) caused by smoking—based on bioinformatics analysis and in vitro experimental evidence. The GEO, GEO2R, TargetScan, miRDB, miRWalk, DAVID, and STRING databases were used for bioinformatics analysis. The mRNA expression and the protein levels were determined by real-time PCR and ELISA.

pmc-10878480.title: A descriptive study of hepatitis C in people who inject drugs
pmc-10878480.creator: Prakrithi Shivaprakash, Vinit Patel, Darshan Shadakshari, Rahul Verma, Lekhansh Shukla, Jayant Mahadevan, Arun Kandasamy, Prabhat Kumar Chand, Vivek Benegal, Lakshmanan Sethuraman, Priyamvada Sharma, Pratima Murthy
pmc-10878480.description: Background & objectives:The seroprevalence of the hepatitis C virus (HCV) in general population is higher than that of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) in India. People who inject drugs (PWIDs) constitute a high-risk group for all blood-borne infections. Multiple behavioural surveillance surveys have provided a rich typology of HIV-infected PWIDs, but this information is missing for HCV infection.

pmc-11604480.title: Effect of remote ischemic preconditioning on cerebral circulation time in severe carotid artery stenosis: Results from the RIC-CCT trial
pmc-11604480.creator: Quan-Ying Liu, Yu Cui, Wei Li, Jing Qiu, Thanh N Nguyen, Hui-Sheng Chen
pmc-11604480.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). SummaryIn patients with severe internal carotid artery stenosis (sICAS), cerebral circulation time (CCT) is associated with cerebral hyperperfusion syndrome. This study aims to investigate the effect of remote ischemic preconditioning (RIC) on CCT in patients with sICAS. Patients are randomly assigned to the RIC group (RIC twice daily, for 2–4 days before carotid artery stenting [CAS] as an adjunct to standard medical therapy) and the control group.

pmc-11679347.title: Educational Intervention on Awareness of Health-Damaging Behaviors in Educators
pmc-11679347.creator: Valentina Focaroli, Marina Chiaro, Maria Vittoria Battaglia, Laura Guidetti, Andrea Velardi
pmc-11679347.description: Doping prevention transcends elite sports, highlighting a broader societal challenge where performance enhancement is driven by pressures to increase strength, beauty, and status. This issue extends to adolescents and non-competitive sports participants, where self-optimization pressures are increasingly normalized. Research underscores the need for tailored educational interventions that go beyond punitive measures, fostering ethical decision-making and personal responsibility.

pmc-12506066.title: Beyond diabetes: harnessing the power of metformin in burn care
pmc-12506066.creator: Fadi Khalaf, Daniella Touma, Sean Saldanha, Georges Khalaf, Dalia Barayan, Marc G Jeschke
pmc-12506066.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Burn injuries are complex and devastating traumas that trigger a profound systemic metabolic response, characterized by hyperglycemia, insulin resistance, and a hypermetabolic state. Notably, hyperglycemia is a critical determinant of worse prognoses in burn patients. While insulin has long been the gold standard for managing post-burn hyperglycemia, its therapy is associated with a risk of hypoglycemic events, which can exacerbate morbidity and compromise patient outcomes. As such, investigation of alternative therapeutics is warranted to improve glycemic control while mitigating associated risks.

pmc-12636231.title: Moroccan and Pakistani women’s knowledge and perceptions on cervical cancer screening and HPV self-sampling acceptability in Catalonia, Spain: a mixed-methods study
pmc-12636231.creator: Jone G. Lurgain, Paula Peremiquel-Trillas, Hakima Ouaarab-Essadek, Khadija Mellouki, Sumaira Malik-Hameed, Andleed Sarif, Valentina Rangel-Sarmiento, Laia Bruni, Guy Harling, Clare Gilham
pmc-12636231.description: BackgroundDisparities in cervical cancer (CC) screening participation persist, with lower rates among immigrant women from low-resource countries compared to native European women. Evidence-based strategies to reach under-screened women are thus needed, such as adopting self-sampling for human papillomavirus (HPV) testing. Studies have demonstrated that women are receptive to HPV self-sampling.

pmc-12683477.title: Factors influencing the pediatric hospitalization experience: a narrative review with recommendations for improvement
pmc-12683477.creator: Pratiksha Patra, Jonathan Wu
pmc-12683477.description: Background and ObjectivePediatric patients view hospitalization as an overwhelmingly negative experience, and this has implications in treatment adherence, patient-provider relationships, and overall health outcomes. Children should be active agents and collaborate with doctors in their medical treatments, and yet, they are frequently excluded in practice and research, suggesting that insight into improving their hospital stay is underexplored.

pmc-12730050.title: Wearable PPG Multi-Sensor for Skin Humidity, Temperature, and Contact Pressure Measurement in Weak Magnetic Field Environment: First-Step Experiments
pmc-12730050.creator: Jiří Přibil, Anna Přibilová, Tomáš Dermek
pmc-12730050.description: This study describes the developed special prototype of a wearable measuring device based on a photoplethysmography (PPG) sensor. It contains also a humidity sensor and a thermometer to measure skin moisture and temperature, and a force-sensitive (FSR) element to sense a contact pressure between the measuring probe and the skin surface.

pmc-13050030.title: Impact of influenza vaccination on in-hospital outcomes among patients with heart failure and acute respiratory illness
pmc-13050030.creator: Aimen Shafiq, Syed Sarmad Javaid, Apurva Popat, Hamza Asif, Mahlika Ahmad, Rehan Ali, Irfa Zaheer, Usama Arshad, Dua Jabeen, Alishba Karim Mandokhail, Danaish Kumar, Saeeda Khanam, F.N.U. Sagar, Muhammad Shariq Usman, Ali Hasan, Raheel Ahmed

pmc-13199852.title: Eosinophil Recruitment and Activity in CNS Lesions of MOG Antibody–Associated Myelitis Following Influenza Vaccination: A Case Report
pmc-13199852.creator: Hiroshi Adachi, Misa Takashima, Naonobu Futamura
pmc-13199852.description: The appearance of eosinophils in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is considered atypical in patients with myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein (MOG) antibody–associated disease (MOGAD). In this article, we report the case of a 24‐year‐old male who received an influenza vaccine and subsequently presented with sensory disturbances in his limbs and trunk, accompanied by urinary retention.

pmc-13210195.title: Unraveling the complexity of nurses’ quality of life: A Fuzzy-Set Qualitative Comparative Analysis (fsQCA) approach to the interplay of psychological, occupational, and social factors
pmc-13210195.creator: Xu Jun, Li Shasha, Mao Dandan, Omnia El Seifi, Ahmed El-Sayed, Ahmed El-Sayed
pmc-13210195.description: AimThis study aimed to explore the interplay among occupational stress, psychological distress, social support, burnout, and work-family conflict in relation to the quality of life (QOL) of nurses.MethodsA total of 503 nurses from two tertiary-level hospitals participated in an online survey. Data were collected on psychological distress, occupational stress, social support, burnout, work-family conflict, and quality of life.

pmc-13440170.title: Artificial intelligence in emergency mechanical ventilation: a prospective observational comparison with emergency physician ventilator settings
pmc-13440170.creator: Gürkan Altuntaş, İsmail Ataş, Mümin Murat Yazıcı, Özlem Bilir, Bünyamin Onur Harmancı, Enes Hamdioğlu, Nurullah Parça
pmc-13440170.description: BackgroundArtificial intelligence (AI) has the potential to support clinicians in high-risk and complex decision-making processes, such as mechanical ventilation. This prospective observational study aimed to compare mechanical ventilator settings determined by emergency physician (EP) with recommendations generated by three large language models (ChatGPT-5, Gemini, and Copilot) in the emergency department (ED).

pmc-13660471.title: BRIDGE-KO: auditable transfer learning with bridged knockoffs improves cross-cohort microbiome prediction of immunotherapy response
pmc-13660471.creator: Jie Sun, Zhenjiang Fan, Rebecca Caldino Bohn, Soyeon Kim, Hyun Jung Park
pmc-13660471.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Transfer learning promises to reuse AI models across biomedical studies, but it often fails when differences between datasets introduce cohort-specific artifacts and ‘negative transfer.’ We present BRIDGE-KO, an interpretable deep-learning framework that turns transfer learning into a testable design process by asking: where to transfer from (source-target coverage and proximity), what to transfer (which representation level is most portable), and how to harmonize data to reduce technical confounding.
